text: Gardening is all about nurturing plants and ensuring their health and growth. Watering is the first step, as it helps keep the soil moist and provides the necessary moisture for the roots to absorb and store. Pruning, on the other hand, is a crucial step that involves removing dead, diseased, or damaged branches to promote healthy growth and prevent the spread of pests and diseases. It also helps keep the plant size in check and encourages the development of new, stronger stems. With proper watering and pruning, your garden will flourish and provide a haven for butterflies, bees, and other pollinators.
